areas.name: Environmental sustainability, adaptation and mitigation
areas.reason: Urban infrastructure upgrades, public transport promotion and tree planting support environmental sustainability and climate mitigation.

areas.name: Energy efficiency and renewable energy
areas.reason: Replacing conventional public lighting with LED fixtures contributes to energy efficiency.

areas.name: Basic sanitation
areas.reason: Expanded drainage infrastructure is a direct sanitation action, reducing flooding and aiding public health.

areas.name: Integrated water-resources management and water security
areas.reason: Greater green and permeable areas relate to soil conservation and permeability, indirectly supporting integrated water management.

areas.name: Infrastructure and social facilities for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Targets underserved communities with infrastructure and social facilities such as sports spaces.

areas.name: Youth, gender and race policies
areas.reason: No specific gender or race policies, but sports training centers target young people in vulnerable areas.

areas.name: Biodiversity and forest resources
areas.reason: Tree planting supports biodiversity but is not the central scope of the project.

areas.name: Business environment and opportunities
areas.reason: Better infrastructure and mobility only indirectly benefit business; not central to the project scope.

areas.name: Individual entrepreneurs and micro/small firms
areas.reason: Improved mobility and accessibility may help local entrepreneurs, but only as an indirect benefit.

areas.name: Jobs and income for low-income and vulnerable groups
areas.reason: Construction-phase jobs and revitalization are an indirect benefit, not the central scope.

areas.name: Inclusion of social minorities
areas.reason: Benefits low-human-development neighborhoods but specifies no direct actions to include social minorities.

areas.name: Public-service delivery, management and citizen participation
areas.reason: Focus is on public infrastructure with no innovation in management processes or citizen participation.

areas.name: Education and health conditions
areas.reason: Sanitation and fewer waterborne diseases give only indirect health and education potential, not central scope.

areas.name: Technological development, innovation and modernization
areas.reason: Lighting modernization is a technology investment but already credited under energy efficiency; no explicit technological focus.

areas.name: Financing arrangements encouraging private participation
areas.reason: No financing arrangements for private participation are specified.
